summary: Iteration 3: 36/36 backend tests pass. Verified (a) critical regression fix — services.painel.renew_user is now importable and callable; (b) new /api/notifications router — list, get single, 404 for invalid, PUT body+image_url, PUT enabled toggle, PUT invalid 404, PUT empty payload 400; (c) POST /api/whatsapp/send accepts new optional image_url field (parses successfully, returns 502 because WA not connected — never 422) with message-only, image-only, and both variants; (d) all iteration_2 regression tests still pass (templates trigger_source, R$ prices, /api/painel/*, dashboard, customers CRUD, messages). Templates seeded correctly for all 5 events: expiration_3d, expiration_1d, expiration_0d, renewal_success, trial_ready. expiration_3d restored to original state after tests.

minor.issue: image_url cannot be cleared to empty string because router filters `v is not None` — sending image_url:'' is accepted but PUT payload logic uses .model_dump() filter that keeps empty string (v is not None). Verified via test — passes. Non-issue but worth noting: to explicitly null-out image_url a client must send '' (empty string), which is stored as-is.
Still may take ~60s (upstream painel/2Captcha) before returning 502/504. Carried over from iter_2.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/notifications.py — no create/delete endpoints; only 5 seeded events are mutable. Fine for MVP but flag if new events need to be added dynamically.

routers/notifications.py update_notification — response_model=NotifTemplate returned even after UPDATE rowcount==0 raises before commit — good. But rowcount check happens before commit; consider adding await db.commit() only after rowcount>0 (already correct).

routers/whatsapp.py send — outgoing save uses '[imagem] <url>' fallback when message empty; message column now stores this placeholder. Consider a dedicated `media_url` column on messages for cleaner history.
services/painel.py — renew_user now exists (regression fix confirmed). Recommend adding a unit test with a mocked http client to exercise a success path in a future iteration.
